title: Provision of Audience Research Services
description: The Board of Trustees for the National Galleries of Scotland ("NGS") wish to award a Contract for the Provision of Audience Research Services. The Service Provider is required to conduct Audience Research to provide insight and analysis about our visitors in order to support the Organisation’s 2030 Strategy, Business Plan and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), special projects and inform organisation-wide strategic planning. The Service Provider shall be a member of, accredited by, or operate in accordance with the standards, codes of conduct and professional requirements of the Market Research Society (MRS) or an equivalent recognised professional body for market research, social research, insight or analytics. This Contract shall primarily provide Fieldwork Surveys and associated Project Management, Client Data Access, Analysis and Reporting for each of our four gallery sites. Services will be agreed to on an “as required” basis with no commitment to a minimum volume of work. NGS may, at its absolute discretion, require the Service Provider to provide Audience Research Services at this fifth site, currently under construction, at any time during the Contract term. If permitted by applicable procurement legislation, where additional audience research requirements arise during the Contract term that constitute an extension of the Services, NGS reserves the right to procure such additional services from the Service Provider. For full details of the Contract Requirements please refer to the associated Tender and Contract Documents. The Service Provider must have a clear understanding of the contract requirements and the organisational needs of NGS. As part of the tender exercise, the Service Provider must detail a robust and flexible methodology for conducting Audience Research Services that will meet all data capture requirements. There is no commitment to a minimum spend over the duration of the Contract. Under this Contract, no minimum spend is guaranteed. The agreement will be non-exclusive i.e. NGS reserves the right, in certain, circumstances, to procure out with the Contract Agreement, as and when required. In the event of unsatisfactory performance by the successful Service Provider and the termination of the contract by either party, NGS reserves the right to negotiate the continuance of the services with the second and third placed Service Providers.

Ofertanții din cadrul acestei proceduri înțeleg că AC nu poate fi considerată răspunzătoare pentru vreun prejudiciu în cazul anulării procedurii de atribuire, indiferent de natura acestuia și indiferent dacă AC fost notificată asupra existenței unui asemenea prejudiciu. Ofertanții din cadrul acestei proceduri acceptă utilizarea condițiilor speciale de mai sus/clauzei suspensive, asumându-și întreaga răspundere în raport cu eventualele prejudicii pe care le-ar putea suferi în situația descrisă.” Clauză de revizuire: Procedura de atribuire a contractelor de achiziție publică este inițiată sub incidența clauzei de revizuire. În temeiul art. 221 alin. (1) litera a) din Legea nr. 98/2016, AC utilizează în cadrul prezentei procedurii de achiziție clauza de revizuire privind opțiunea de suplimentare a perioadei contractuale inițiale. Mai exact, în situația identificării unei/unor surse de finanțare, autoritatea contractantă poate prelungi perioada de valabilitate a contractului cu maxim 60 luni, suplimentar perioadei inițiale. Valoarea totală estimată a achiziției a fost stabilită cu includerea opțiunii de suplimentare. Având în vedere modalitatea de aplicare a clauzei de revizuire, propunerea financiară va fi formulată pentru perioada certă pe care AC se poate angaja contractual, respectiv 12 luni (365 zile). Pentru prelungirea perioadei de valabilitate a contractului, în situația identificării unei/unor surse de finanțare, urmează să se încheie un act adițional la contractul inițial, în conformitate cu prevederile art. 221 din Legea nr. 98/2016, și ale Instrucțiunii Președintelui ANAP nr. 1 /2021. În situația în care, prin aplicarea clauzei de rev ref la opțiunea de suplimentare a perioadei contractuale inițiale, perioada de valabilitate a contractului va depăși 24 luni, prețul unitar va fi ajustat astfel: începând cu prima zi de la împlinirea celor 24 luni de la semnarea contr, pentru determinarea prețului unitar în lei a serviciilor, inclusiv serviciile conexe, ce va fi utilizat pentru stabilirea valorii contr, se va utiliza următoarea formulă de ajustare, respectiv: PUa= (PUi * IPC)/100 PUa– repr prețul unitar ajustat; PUi-repr prețul unitar inițial; IPC – reprezintă indicele prețului de consum anual comunicat de INS pentru anul anterior celui în care se dorește încheierea contr (https://insse.ro/cms/ro/content/ipc%E2%80%93serie-de-date-anuala). description: Background and purpose Arendal is located in the central part of Sørlandet. The municipality has approx. 46,000 inhabitants. Arendal municipality has a decentralised school structure with 16 municipal primary and secondary schools, organised as independent entities with separate rectors and management groups. The schools include both combined 1st - 10th schools and pure primary schools (1st - 7th years), as well as a resource centre with tenders across the stages. The municipality has a total of approx. 5,000 pupils in the primary and lower secondary schools. Arendal municipality is in an ongoing change of the school structure. The cooperation between the school office and the schools will take place, among other things, through fixed meeting points and joint development work, at the same time that each school adapts the work to local needs. The adult education is organised as a part of the municipality ́s training and is also a user of relevant digital services. Arendal municipality needs a joint system for the administration, distribution and access management of digital teaching aids in primary and secondary schools. The municipality has used a system for this purpose over time and has developed good experience with procurement, licence management and access management in this area. title: Norway – Graphic design services – Graphic services
description: Background Arendal municipality has an ongoing need for graphical services connected to information material and visual communication aimed at inhabitants and internal target groups. The municipality produces some material itself, but needs external assistance for assignments that are more complex, time consuming or require special professional competence. The procurement shall ensure access to capacity and relevant competence within graphical design, at the same time as the municipality takes care of the need for uniform visual communication and clear identity. The municipality shall be one sender. It is also important to ensure that material and visual deliveries fulfil the requirements for universal design and ensure accessible and understandable communication for different user groups. The municipality therefore needs to establish a new framework agreement that provides predictable access to graphical assistance as needed, both for smaller ongoing assignments and for major or more strategic deliveries. The assignments will vary in extent and complexity. The municipality needs a tenderer who can assist with both smaller, limited assignments and large deliveries that require more planning and close cooperation with the contracting authority. Minor assignments means limited deliveries such as, for example, an ad, poster, presentation or simple illustration. Larger deliveries means assignments that include planning, coordination and multiple sub-services, such as a report or campaign material. The deliveries shall be able to be used further in the municipality ́s own channels and tools, and it is important that the deliveries can be further developed and adapted internally. The framework agreement shall also include the design of profile material and profile articles, as well as graphic materials connected to the use of, among other things, vehicles, buildings and work clothes. Web design for arendal.kommune.no is not included in the procurement. It is important to have clear contact points, effective clarifications and a good understanding of the municipality ́s graphical profile, communication needs and targets for clear, available and recognisable communication.

The purpose is to provide a timely, up-to-date compendium of daily information, in the form of press reviews, about the way in which topics of relevance to the European Parliament and the European Union are reported in the media. The European Parliament’s Directorate-General for Communication is seeking to ensure it has the best possible knowledge of the media coverage across the EU on topics related to the European Union, the European Parliament and the activities of its President and Members. Media analysis will ultimately help the EP to better communicate EU policies to EU citizens and specific target audiences. In order to achieve this, the EP relies partly on external expertise and assistance. The services will be delivered by the external team via the global media monitoring and analysis platform of the EP directly to the recipients.

title: Netherlands – Postal services – Postdienstverlening
description: Procedure Aanbesteding middels de Europees openbare procedure conform de (gewijzigde) aanbestedingswet 2012. Opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever bij deze aanbesteding is de Gemeente Breda. Voor meer informatie over de Gemeente Breda verwijzen wij u naar de website van de gemeente: www.breda.nl. Scope van de opdracht De opdracht omvat de integrale postdienstverlening voor de gemeente Breda, waaronder in ieder geval: het ophalen, sorteren, vervoeren en bezorgen van geadresseerde poststukken; het ophalen, sorteren, vervoeren en bezorgen van pakketten; het verwerken en bezorgen van verkiezingspost; het verwerken van retourzendingen; Haalservice (postbus)post en Brengservcie (postbus)post; het verzorgen van aangetekende poststukken (Binnenland en Buitenland) en overige bijzondere postdiensten; het verzorgen van kwaliteitsborging en prestatiemonitoring. De exacte omvang en inhoud van de dienstverlening zijn nader uitgewerkt in het Programma van Eisen en de SLA. Buiten de scope valt: verspreiding huis aan huis berichten (gemeentelijke berichten) en fietskoersdiensten. Percelen Deze opdracht is niet verdeeld in percelen. Doel Het afsluiten van een raamovereenkomst met één contractpartij voor het verzorgen van de postdienstverlening ten behoeve van gemeente Breda. Deze raamovereenkomst zal worden aangegaan voor een periode van 2 jaar. De ingangsdatum van deze raamovereenkomst is 1 februari 2027. De opdrachtgever heeft bij wederzijds goedvinden van partijen het recht deze raamovereenkomst tegen dezelfde voorwaarden en condities twee (2) maal te verlengen, telkens voor de duur van één (1) jaar. De maximale looptijd van de raamovereenkomst bedraagt derhalve vier (4) jaar. De besluitvorming ten aanzien van deze verlenging(en) geschiedt op basis van evaluatie van de geleverde prestaties van de dienstverlening. Gunning en motivatie De aanbestedende dienst gunt de opdracht aan de inschrijver op basis van het gunningscriterium laagste prijs, omdat de gevraagde dienstverlening volledig, objectief en eenduidig is gespecificeerd in het Programma van Eisen, de Service Level Agreement (SLA) en de raamovereenkomst. De vereiste kwaliteit van de dienstverlening is volledig vastgelegd in minimumeisen, prestatie-eisen, KPI's en contractvoorwaarden ten aanzien van onder meer bezorgkwaliteit, bestelkwaliteit, verkiezingspost, klachtenafhandeling, managementrapportages, continuïteit, traceerbaarheid, informatiebeveiliging en duurzaamheid. Alle inschrijvers dienen onvoorwaardelijk aan deze eisen te voldoen. De aanbestedende dienst is van oordeel dat inschrijvers zich hierdoor niet wezenlijk op kwaliteit kunnen onderscheiden zonder af te wijken van de gestelde eisen. Aanbestedende dienst is voornemens de opdracht te gunnen aan de inschrijver die een geldige inschrijving heeft ingediend en de laagste totale inschrijfprijs heeft aangeboden. Maximale contractwaarde De maximale opdrachtwaarde in het kader van deze overeenkomst wordt gesteld op € 2.000.000,- bezien over de looptijd van de overeenkomst, inclusief verlengingsopties. Aan het genoemde bedrag kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. Voor opdrachtgever geldt geen afnameverplichting. Mocht gedurende de looptijd van de raamovereenkomst de maximale opdrachtwaarde worden overschreden dan zal de raamovereenkomst (eerder) worden beëindigd. Mercell Deze aanbesteding zal uitsluitend en geheel digitaal online worden afgehandeld via het Mercell platform (www.mercell.com). Een uitgebreide instructie met betrekking tot digitaal aanbesteden treft u aan in de Vragenlijsten.

title: Passenger Lift Replacement Within Diplomatic Mission
description: This project involves the refurbishment and upgrade of the existing passenger lift installation at CH, London. The scope includes the full removal and replacement of the lift car, associated shaft equipment, and integration with the building's lift controls and life safety systems. Works are to be undertaken in a live, high-security diplomatic building, requiring strict adherence to security protocols, with minimal disruption to operations. The contract requires the provision of a compliant lift installation in accordance with BS EN 81-72:2020, BS 9999, and relevant Building Regulations, including Approved Document B. All works must meet or exceed the performance, safety, and accessibility standards expected for lift installations in a commercial/public building setting. Contractors will be expected to coordinate closely with heritage, building services, and security stakeholders, ensuring integration with existing infrastructure and minimal aesthetic impact on listed features. Specific interface requirements include BMS integration, fire alarm interlocks, and mechanical ventilation enhancements within the shaft to meet smoke control provisions. The successful contractor will be required to deliver a complete design, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning package, inclusive of all enabling works, builders' work in connection, and certification. title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Bereitstellung, Customizing, Betrieb sowie Weiterentwicklung eines landesweiten touristischen Datenmanagementsystems
description: Die Ausschreibung umfasst folgende Arbeitspakete: Arbeitspaket 1: Feinkonzeption als Vorarbeit zur Umsetzung von Arbeitspaket 2 Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst die nötigen Feinkonzeptionen für die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems. In der Feinkonzeption sind insbesondere folgende Punkte zu bearbeiten: - Gesamtarchitektur (Hard- und Software, Instanzen- und Mandantenmodell) - Datenmodellierung, -auszeichnung und -repräsentation - Rollen- und Rechtesystem, Benutzergruppen - Benutzeroberflächen / UI (Dateneingabe) - Qualitätsstandards und Doublettenprüfung bzw. -konsolidierung - Datensynchronisation zwischen Instanzen sowie Konnektoren beim Import aus externen Datenmanagementsystemen via API - Umsetzung der Complianceanforderungen (Barrierearmut, Datenschutz, Gesetze / Verordnungen (EU KI Act, EmpCo etc.) - Repräsentanz der Daten beim Export im Ausgabemanagement der Daten - Dashboards für das Systemmanagement und das Monitoring (KPIs) - initiale Datenmigration für den Import aus den bestehenden Dateninventaren Arbeitspaket 2: Customizing (Eingabe- und Ausgabemanagement), inkl. Datenmigration, Schulungen und Dokumentation Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst im Kern die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems aufbauend auf Arbeitspaket 1. Dies umfasst die Umsetzung der Standardsettings (Datenmodell, Rollen / Rechte, Oberflächen, API-Management, etc.) und die Einrichtung von 12 Instanzen inkl. Datensynchronisation. Zur Einführung des Systems ist zudem eine Datenmigration aus den Altsystemen sowie zwei Legacy APIs (XML) zur Aufrechterhaltung der Datenflüsse für Schnittstellenkonsumenten zu den bisherigen Datensystemen umzusetzen. Das Arbeitspaket umfasst die Schulung für die TMB (Administratoren und Betreiber regionaler Instanzen), Schulungsunterlagen und eine Dokumentation. Arbeitspaket 3: Betrieb des API-Managements Die API-Infrastruktur soll im Rahmen des Projektes von der historisch gewachsenen Logik der XML-Exporte auf ein modernes API-Management umgestellt werden. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb des API-Managements des Datenmanagementsystems und stellt die zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Bereitstellung der APIs für die anzuschließenden Nutzer sicher. Arbeitspaket 4: Systembetrieb, Hosting, Support Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb, das Hosting und den technischen Support des Datenmanagementsystems einschließlich der hierfür erforderlichen Systemkomponenten und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Verfügbarkeit während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Hierzu gehört insbesondere die Überwachung der Systemumgebung, Wartung und Aktualisierung der eingesetzten Komponenten sowie die Bearbeitung und Behebung von technischen Störungen. Für den laufenden Systembetrieb und das Hosting aller Komponenten werden die folgenden Leistungen gefordert, die entweder von dem Auftragnehmer direkt oder durch den Auftragnehmer zu beauftragende Dritte zu erbringen sind. In beiden Fällen ist der Auftragnehmer zentraler Ansprechpartner für den Auftraggeber und hat (ggf. gemeinsam mit seinen Subunternehmern bzw. die zu benennenden Dritten) die nachfolgenden Anforderungen sicherzustellen. Arbeitspaket 5: Konzeption und Aufbau / Integration einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur in das Datenmanagementsystem Graph-RAG-fähige Services sind dort notwendig, wo faktenbasierte, kontextsensitive Antworten aus kuratierten Inhalten mit KI-Systemen erzeugt werden sollen, etwa im Tourismusnetzwerk (als landesweites Informationssystem bspw. für Touristinformationen), in Serviceassistenten, Chatbots oder in internen Wissenssystemen. Um hier zukunftsfähig zu werden, wird dieses Arbeitspaket ausgeschrieben. Arbeitspaket 6: Betrieb einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den technischen Betrieb der für die TMB bereitgestellten Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Nutzung während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Der Betrieb umfasst insb. die Verfügbarkeit der erforderlichen Komponenten für die semantische Suche und Bereitstellung von Wissen für die angeschlossenen Anwendungen. Arbeitspaket 7: Weiterentwicklung des Datenmanagementsystems und der angeschlossenen Komponenten Dieses Arbeitspaket dient der Kalkulation von Weiterentwicklungsaufträgen, die durch Einzelbeauftragung ausgelöst und umgesetzt werden. Arbeitspaket 8: Consulting für das API-Management Der Auftragnehmer soll die TMB bei der Beratung und Betreuung der rund 200 bestehenden und neu hinzukommenden Nutzer der APIs des Datenmanagementsystems unterstützen. Ziel ist es, die API-Nutzer bei der individuellen Nutzung, Konfiguration und Weiterentwicklung ihrer Datenanbindungen fachlich und technisch zu unterstützen und eine möglichst reibungslose Nutzung der bereitgestellten Datenströme sicherzustellen. Das Volumen des Auftrages beträgt geschätzt 332.500,00 Euro für einen Zeitraum von vier Jahren.

title: Netherlands – Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses) – Supply and Analysis of NH₃ Passive Samplers (Diffusion Tubes) for the MAN Network and additional projects
description: This European tender concerns a contract for the supply and laboratory analysis of ammonia (NH₃) passive samplers (diffusion tubes) for the Dutch ammonia monitoring network “Meetnet Ammoniak Nederland” (MAN) and various additional projects. The contractor will be responsible for the monthly supply of unexposed diffusion tubes to RIVM, the analysis of exposed tubes supplied by RIVM, and the digital reporting of validated results. Field deployment, return logistics of exposed tubes and internal data processing by RIVM fall outside the scope. The expected annual volume ranges from approximately 6,600 tubes in the baseline MAN scenario up to around 9,900 tubes including additional projects, with a maximum bandwidth of up to 30,000 tubes per year to accommodate future growth. If the contract is awarded to a new supplier, the first contract year will include a structured Double Measurement Programme, in which the new laboratory’s performance is systematically compared with the current trend laboratory to ensure continuity and trend stability in the MAN data series. The contract is tendered as one single, integrated lot combining tube supply, analysis and reporting with one contractor, using a best price‑quality ratio award criterion. The agreement has a fixed initial duration of six (6) years starting 1 January 2027, with five (5) optional one‑year extensions, for a maximum total duration of eleven (11) years.

title: Norway – Vehicle-fleet management services – Contract for the purchase, leasing and operation of vehicles.
description: 1 General Description 1.1 About the Contracting Authority The contracting authority for this competition is Møre og Romsdal county, c/o the County Road Department. See the website www.mrfylke.no for information on the Contracting Authority. 1.2 About the Assignment - the objective of the procurement 1.2.1 Purpose The contracting authority needs to enter into a contract with a supplier of vehicle administration. The procurement/agreement shall include both the purchase (new vehicle) and leasing (operational) of official vehicles as well as vehicle administration of official cars. The contracting authority needs a system that ensures a modern, economic, safe and environmentally friendly vehicle fleet as well as an intuitive administration of the fleet of vehicles. The chosen tenderer must also be an advisory and solution orientated cooperation partner. 1.2.2 Extent As stated in point 1.2.1, the contract shall include: 1. Purchase and leasing (operational) of official vehicles 2. Vehicle administration with travel log and fleet management (option). Delivery under point 1: As regards the procurement of a new vehicle under point 1, the competition concludes that tenders will not be submitted for concrete vehicle models, but on vehicle groups. The choice of a specific type of vehicle within the defined vehicle groups will be made when ordered during the contract period. Examples of vehicle types that will be ordered are in the price form, annex 4, tab 4. If the vehicle is procured, the tenderer shall act as a "communicator" where he collects tender offers based on predetermined procedures, cf. The assignment description annex point 1.1.2 Selection of vehicles/tenders is to be made by the contracting authority. The price of this service (facilitation) is an award per vehicle. There is a price for this communication fee that is being competed on. When leasing, suppliers offer vehicles within defined vehicle groups, where prices for leasing are calculated according to cost price, i.e. purchase price with deduction for discounts + specified equipment and possibly fittings. The price of the leasing is limited based on cost price, hire period, NIBOR interest + fixed mark-up percentage and calculated remaining value. title: Bereitstellung, Customizing, Betrieb sowie Weiterentwicklung eines landesweiten touristischen Datenmanagementsystems
description: Die Ausschreibung umfasst folgende Arbeitspakete: Arbeitspaket 1: Feinkonzeption als Vorarbeit zur Umsetzung von Arbeitspaket 2 Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst die nötigen Feinkonzeptionen für die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems. In der Feinkonzeption sind insbesondere folgende Punkte zu bearbeiten: - Gesamtarchitektur (Hard- und Software, Instanzen- und Mandantenmodell) - Datenmodellierung, -auszeichnung und -repräsentation - Rollen- und Rechtesystem, Benutzergruppen - Benutzeroberflächen / UI (Dateneingabe) - Qualitätsstandards und Doublettenprüfung bzw. -konsolidierung - Datensynchronisation zwischen Instanzen sowie Konnektoren beim Import aus externen Datenmanagementsystemen via API - Umsetzung der Complianceanforderungen (Barrierearmut, Datenschutz, Gesetze / Verordnungen (EU KI Act, EmpCo etc.) - Repräsentanz der Daten beim Export im Ausgabemanagement der Daten - Dashboards für das Systemmanagement und das Monitoring (KPIs) - initiale Datenmigration für den Import aus den bestehenden Dateninventaren Arbeitspaket 2: Customizing (Eingabe- und Ausgabemanagement), inkl. Datenmigration, Schulungen und Dokumentation Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst im Kern die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems aufbauend auf Arbeitspaket 1. Dies umfasst die Umsetzung der Standardsettings (Datenmodell, Rollen / Rechte, Oberflächen, API-Management, etc.) und die Einrichtung von 12 Instanzen inkl. Datensynchronisation. Zur Einführung des Systems ist zudem eine Datenmigration aus den Altsystemen sowie zwei Legacy APIs (XML) zur Aufrechterhaltung der Datenflüsse für Schnittstellenkonsumenten zu den bisherigen Datensystemen umzusetzen. Das Arbeitspaket umfasst die Schulung für die TMB (Administratoren und Betreiber regionaler Instanzen), Schulungsunterlagen und eine Dokumentation. Arbeitspaket 3: Betrieb des API-Managements Die API-Infrastruktur soll im Rahmen des Projektes von der historisch gewachsenen Logik der XML-Exporte auf ein modernes API-Management umgestellt werden. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb des API-Managements des Datenmanagementsystems und stellt die zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Bereitstellung der APIs für die anzuschließenden Nutzer sicher. Arbeitspaket 4: Systembetrieb, Hosting, Support Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb, das Hosting und den technischen Support des Datenmanagementsystems einschließlich der hierfür erforderlichen Systemkomponenten und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Verfügbarkeit während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Hierzu gehört insbesondere die Überwachung der Systemumgebung, Wartung und Aktualisierung der eingesetzten Komponenten sowie die Bearbeitung und Behebung von technischen Störungen. Für den laufenden Systembetrieb und das Hosting aller Komponenten werden die folgenden Leistungen gefordert, die entweder von dem Auftragnehmer direkt oder durch den Auftragnehmer zu beauftragende Dritte zu erbringen sind. In beiden Fällen ist der Auftragnehmer zentraler Ansprechpartner für den Auftraggeber und hat (ggf. gemeinsam mit seinen Subunternehmern bzw. die zu benennenden Dritten) die nachfolgenden Anforderungen sicherzustellen. Arbeitspaket 5: Konzeption und Aufbau / Integration einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur in das Datenmanagementsystem Graph-RAG-fähige Services sind dort notwendig, wo faktenbasierte, kontextsensitive Antworten aus kuratierten Inhalten mit KI-Systemen erzeugt werden sollen, etwa im Tourismusnetzwerk (als landesweites Informationssystem bspw. für Touristinformationen), in Serviceassistenten, Chatbots oder in internen Wissenssystemen. Um hier zukunftsfähig zu werden, wird dieses Arbeitspaket ausgeschrieben. Arbeitspaket 6: Betrieb einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den technischen Betrieb der für die TMB bereitgestellten Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Nutzung während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Der Betrieb umfasst insb. die Verfügbarkeit der erforderlichen Komponenten für die semantische Suche und Bereitstellung von Wissen für die angeschlossenen Anwendungen. Arbeitspaket 7: Weiterentwicklung des Datenmanagementsystems und der angeschlossenen Komponenten Dieses Arbeitspaket dient der Kalkulation von Weiterentwicklungsaufträgen, die durch Einzelbeauftragung ausgelöst und umgesetzt werden. Arbeitspaket 8: Consulting für das API-Management Der Auftragnehmer soll die TMB bei der Beratung und Betreuung der rund 200 bestehenden und neu hinzukommenden Nutzer der APIs des Datenmanagementsystems unterstützen. Ziel ist es, die API-Nutzer bei der individuellen Nutzung, Konfiguration und Weiterentwicklung ihrer Datenanbindungen fachlich und technisch zu unterstützen und eine möglichst reibungslose Nutzung der bereitgestellten Datenströme sicherzustellen. Das Volumen des Auftrages beträgt geschätzt 332.500,00 Euro für einen Zeitraum von vier Jahren.

Prezentul proiect are următoarele obiective: ➢ 1. Implementarea unui sistem de autentificare prin recunoaștere facială pentru a facilita accesul rapid și eficient la birourile primăriei, contribuind la reducerea cozilor și a timpului de așteptare. - SOLUȚIE CONTROL ACCES DIGITAL ÎN PRIMĂRIE ➢ 2. Implementarea unui modul destinat gestionării automate a pontajelor, concediilor și statisticilor de prezență, optimizând astfel procesele administrative interne. - SOLUȚIE DE RESURSE UMANE ➢ 3. Utilizarea tehnologiei avansate pentru a înregistra ședințele oficiale și a transforma automat înregistrările audio în transcrieri scrise, facilitând astfel accesul la informații. - SOLUȚIE DE ÎNREGISTRARE, DOCUMENTARE ȘI DISEMINARE A ȘEDINȚELOR ➢ 4. Crearea unor canale diverse de comunicare pentru cetățeni, inclusiv chatbots pentru asistență non-stop și implementarea unui sistem de bugetare participativă, permițând cetățenilor să se implice activ în deciziile administrative - SOLUȚIE DE COMUNICARE CU CETĂȚENII ȘI BUGETARE PARTICIPATIVĂ ➢ 5. Oferirea de materiale educative și sesiuni informative pentru a conștientiza cetățenii despre importanța participării lor în procesul bugetării, precum și despre alte subiecte relevante pentru comunitate - SOLUȚIE DE EDUCARE ȘI DEZVOLTARE DURABILĂ Durata contractului: Durata de prestare a serviciilor prevăzute în prezentul contract este de 6 luni până la recepția finală a serviciilor, începând de la data semnării contractului de către ambele părți sub rezerva constituirii garantiei de buna executie. Termenul pentru recepția cantitativă a soluției este de maxim 5 luni iar termenul pentru recepția calitativă este de cel mult 6 luni calculat de la data semnării contractului de către ambele părți, sub rezerva constituirii garanției de buna execuție. Termenii și condițiile contractului includ și o garanție de cel puțin 2 ani. Perioada de garanție decurge de la data recepției finale şi este egală cel puțin cu perioadele stabilite în caietul de sarcini. În accepțiunea prevederilor art. 2 pct. 42 din Regulamentul (UE) 2021/1060, noțiunea de „imunizare la schimbările climatice” înseamnă un proces de prevenire a vulnerabilității infrastructurii la potențialele efecte pe termen lung ale schimbărilor climatice, asigurându-se în același timp respectarea principiului „eficiența energetică înainte de toate” și faptul că nivelul emisiilor de gaze cu efect de seră generate de proiect este compatibil cu obiectivul privind neutralitatea climatică stabilit pentru 2050; In conformitate cu prevederile art.160 alin. title: Netherlands – Articulated trucks – Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem CLAS - Matlogco - Witte Vloot
description: Bedrijfsprofiel De Aanbestedende dienst is het Materieellogistiek Commando Land (MatlogCo) van de Koninklijke Landmacht - een van de zeven onderdelen van het Ministerie van Defensie. Het MatlogCo is verantwoordelijk voor de instandhouding van het grondgebonden materieel van Defensie. Voor meer informatie over het Ministerie van Defensie en het MatlogCo is de website www.defensie.nl te raadplegen. Dynamisch aankoopsysteem De hierbij gebruikte procedure is het Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem uit de Aanbestedingswet 2012. De procedure verloopt volledig elektronisch via het online aanbestedingsplatform Negometrix. Een Dynamisch aankoopsysteem (DAS) is een elektronisch proces voor het doen van gangbare aankopen van werken, leveringen of diensten, waarvan de kenmerken wegens de algemene beschikbaarheid op de markt voldoen aan onze behoeften. Doelstelling DAS De doelstelling van het DAS is een zo groot mogelijke groep kwalitatief goede ondernemingen toe te laten zonder de beheersbaarheid te verliezen. Op deze manier creëert Defensie een optimale marktwerking, waarbij Defensie kwalitatief optimale Producten kan selecteren tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten, binnen de gewenste levertijden. Het MatlogCo beoogt hiermee op een eerlijke wijze, snel en eenvoudig haar behoeften op te vullen, door middel van volledige concurrentiestelling. description: NAWCTSD will host a Pre-solicitation Teleconference (mini-Industry Day) for the CH-53E Baseline Configuration Upgrade (BCU) focused exclusively on the Future Airborne Capability Environment (FACE) Technical Standard. This standard is referenced for the development of software as a part of solicitation N61340-17-R-0035. The pre-solicitation teleconference will take place on Thursday, 06 April 2017 from 1:00 - 3:00 pm EDT. The pre-solicitation teleconference will include a dedicated question and answer period allowing contractors to ask any questions related to the FACE portion of solicitation N61340-17-R-0035. Answers to the questions generated from this pre-solicitation teleconference will be provided to all potential offerors. However, it should be noted that, all questions to the stated solicitation, unrelated to FACE, shall continue to follow normal protocol, with contractors submitting a completed L-1 Question and Answer Form and emailing it to Nicole Knight at Nicole.knight@navy.mil. All interested TSC III Lot II vendors are welcome to call in to this teleconference and should request the dial-in number from NAWCTSD Contracts, Nicole Knight (nicole.knight@navy.mil) no later than 2:30 pm EDT on Wednesday, 05 April 2017. In this request, include your company name, attendees’ names, email addresses, phone numbers, and company address to confirm attendance. Subcontractor requests must be requested through the Prime Contractor. All attendees’ for each company are encouraged to use only one call-in line. The Future Airborne Capability Environment (FACE) Technical Standard is the open avionics standard for making military computing operations more robust, interoperable, portable and secure. The standard enables developers to create and deploy a wide catalog of applications for use across the entire spectrum of military aviation systems through a common operating environment, resulting in lower implementation costs, standards that support a robust architecture and enable quality software development, more capabilities reaching the warfighter faster, and innovation and competition within the avionics industry. FACE is maintained by The Open Group FACE Consortium, a government and industry partnership to define an open avionics environment for all military airborne platform types. The FACE Consortium is a vendor-neutral forum that provides standardized approaches for using open standards with avionics systems. The FACE Consortium works to develop and consolidate FACE open standards, best practices, guidance documents and business models. The Government has included a brief entitled “FACE 101�? for interested contractors to review prior to the teleconference. A NAVAIR Subject Matter Expert (SME) will present this briefing and attendees are encouraged to download the briefing so that they can follow along as he presents the materials. For more information regarding FACE, including the FACE Standards, FACE Data Architecture, The Open Group Architecture Framework Technical Reference Model, and related documentation, please visit the Open Group website at: http://www.opengroup.org/face. Failure of an offeror to call-in to the conference or to submit any questions will be construed to mean that the offeror fully understands all requirements of the solicitation. The Future Airborne Capability Environment (FACE) Technical Standard is the open avionics standard for making military computing operations more robust, interoperable, portable and secure. The standard enables developers to create and deploy a wide catalog of applications for use across the entire spectrum of military aviation systems through a common operating environment, resulting in lower implementation costs, standards that support a robust architecture and enable quality software development, more capabilities reaching the warfighter faster, and innovation and competition within the avionics industry. FACE is maintained by The Open Group FACE Consortium, a government and industry partnership to define an open avionics environment for all military airborne platform types. The FACE Consortium is a vendor-neutral forum that provides standardized approaches for using open standards with avionics systems. The FACE Consortium works to develop and consolidate FACE open standards, best practices, guidance documents and business models. title: Market Survey � Industry Insights on Industrialized Construction (IC) Methodologies for Army Installation Resilience
description: 1. INTRODUCTION & PURPOSE This Special Notice is issued solely for market research, information, and planning purposes�it does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Quote (RFQ), or Invitation for Bid (IFB). There is no commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation, make awards, or pay for any costs incurred by respondents in preparing responses to this notice. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Europe District (NAU) querying the commercial marketplace to gauge industry capabilities, technical maturity, commercial availability, and execution strategies regarding Industrialized Construction (IC) and alternative construction methodologies. The objective of this market survey is to obtain strategic industry feedback to operationalize recent Department of the Army policy directives aimed at accelerating infrastructure delivery, reducing initial capital costs, and increasing real property portfolio flexibility. 2. BACKGROUND & STRATEGIC INTENT In accordance with the Department of the Army Memorandum (Facility Construction Policy Implementing Installation Resilience through Industrialized Construction (IC) Methodologies), the Army is transforming how it plans, designs, and constructs facility assets. Traditional design-bid-build processes and on-site construction methods are too slow and costly to keep pace with modem operational requirements. The intent is to accelerate the delivery of critical infrastructure, reduce initial capital costs, and increase the flexibility of the Army's real property portfolio to meet rapidly evolving warfighter requirements. Historically, Army facilities have been engineered for 50-year lifespans, often becoming functionally obsolete before structurally deficient. Moving forward, facilities will be designed to optimize an approximately 25-year lifespan. This provides strategic agility to align with supported platforms and enables rapid recapitalization by allowing structures to be repurposed or relocated as missions change. As a result, the Army seeks to transition to modern Industrialized Construction methodologies targeting: 50% faster delivery timeline compared to traditional construction. 30% reduction in initial capital costs. Optimization for an approximate 25-year facility lifespan (moving away from traditional 50-year engineering baselines) to enable strategic agility, rapid recapitalization, repurposing, or relocation as operational missions evolve. 3. TOPICS OF INTEREST: IC METHODOLOGIES & FACILITY APPLICATIONS NAU is specifically seeking industry capabilities and technical feedback regarding five (5) primary alternative construction methodologies (Ref: ASA IE&E Memo, Para 3.a�e) as applied to three (3) key facility categories (Ref: ASA IE&E Memo, Para 5.a�c), though application to other repeatable facility types is also welcomed. A. Directed Alternative Construction Methodologies (Memo Para 3.a�e) Volumetric Modular Construction: Off-site manufactured three-dimensional volumetric units transported and assembled on-site. Kit of Parts (Panelized) / Pre-Cast Systems: Prefabricated components, wall panels, and structural assemblies designed for specific building configurations. Pre-Engineered Metal Buildings (PEMB): Standardized, scalable steel structural systems. Tension Fabric Structures (TFS): Rapidly deployable aluminum or steel-framed engineered fabric structures. Additive Manufacturing (3D Printing): Automated, on-site or near-site concrete/composite 3D printing systems. B. Primary Target Facility Applications (Memo Para 5.a�c) Category 1: Aircraft Hangars (Para 5.a) Primary Focus: Application of Tension Fabric Structures (TFS) providing clear-span workspaces and environmental protection, erected in a fraction of traditional construction timelines. Category 2: Maintenance Facilities (Para 5.b) Primary Focus: Application of Pre-Engineered Metal Buildings (PEMB) or Panelized Steel Structures capable of supporting heavy-duty overhead cranes while standardizing procurement and accelerating erection. Category 3: Barracks, Child Development Centers (CDCs), Kennels, & Repeatable Buildings (Para 5.c) Primary Focus: Application of Volumetric Modular Construction, Kit of Parts, or Additive Manufacturing (3D Printing) offering high off-site quality control, enhanced thermal performance, and rapid occupancy turnaround. 4. CORE CAPABILITY & EXPERIENCE INQUIRIES ("THE PULSE") Interested sources are requested to provide clear, concise responses to the following core inquiries: Section A: Firm Overview & Strategic Alignment General Capability: Briefly describe your firm�s primary business model, technical focus, manufacturing capacity (if applicable), and experience operating as a prime contractor or key technology partner in Industrialized Construction. Target Scope & Capacity: What is your firm�s ideal project scale (e.g., square footage, dollar value, or unit volume per year) for delivering IC solutions? Section B: Technical Evaluation of Methodologies (Memo 3.a�e vs 5.a�c) Methodology Alignment: Detail your firm�s specific capabilities and execution track record in one or more of the following: -Volumetric Modular -Kit of Parts / Panelized Pre-Cast -Pre-Engineered Metal Buildings (PEMB) -Tension Fabric Structures (TFS) -Additive Manufacturing (3D Printing) Facility Application & Suitability: How well do your IC methodologies integrate with the designated facility types (Hangars, Maintenance Shops, Barracks/CDCs/Repeatable Structures)? What technical modifications or building code considerations are critical for DoD adoption? Are there other facility types that are not included in this announcement that your firm believes would be good candidates for IC methodologies? 25-Year Lifespan & Flexibility Optimization: With the Department of War�s stated objective of reducing the expected lifespan of these facilities to be constructed from 50 years to 25 years in order to achieve lower investment and maintenance costs, do you believe that the IC construction methodologies contemplated by this memorandum are viable delivery methods to meet the 25 year life span expectation? How do the IC methodology capabilities that your company possesses a 25-year optimized lifecycle? Discuss disassembly, relocation, structural repurposing, and recapitalization advantages of your system compared to traditional 50-year brick-and-mortar builds. Section C: Cost, Schedule, & Delivery Optimization Speed & Cost Metrics: How can your firm achieve or approach the Army's benchmark goals of 50% faster delivery and a 30% cost reduction? Supply Chain & Logistics: What are the key supply chain, manufacturing lead time, or transportation constraints associated with scaling your IC methodology across domestic (CONUS) and/or overseas (OCONUS) military installations? Contracting & Delivery Models: What project delivery models best support your manufacturing and installation workflows? Section D: Sourced Experience & Project History Provide up to three (3) representative project examples completed within the past five (5) years demonstrating successful implementation of IC methodologies. For each project, specify: Facility type and delivery methodology utilized (from Para 3.a�e). Timeline comparison (design/fabrication/erection time vs traditional estimated baseline). Cost performance and life-cycle/re-use features. Key lessons learned and recommendations for Government adoption. 5. SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS Firms possessing the capability, experience, and interest in supporting the Army's Industrialized Construction policy are invited to submit their responses in accordance with the following parameters: Response Parameters: Page Limit: Not to exceed ten (10) pages total (including cover page and attachments). Format: Microsoft Word (.docx) or Adobe PDF (.pdf) format, standard 12-pt font. Submittal Address: Submissions must be sent electronically via email to: Primary POC: andrew.a.cochran@usace.army.mil Secondary POC: ryan.s.shoemake

title: DA10--DSS DataBridge Maintenance and Support (VA-27-00000586)
description: NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE The purpose of this synopsis is to announce the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Technology Acquisition Center s intent to award a firm-fixed-price sole source contract with Document Storage Systems Incorporated (DSS), located at 701 U.S.Highway One, Suite 101, North Palm Beach, Florida 33408. VA, Veterans health Administration (VHS), Veterans Integrated Service Network (VISN) 17 has a requirement for DSS DataBridge annual software license subscriptions, maintenance, support, and associated installation, integration and testing for its existing DataBridge environment. VISN 17 Health Care Systems currently utilize DSS DataBridge software licenses to facilitate communication and integration between the Draeger anesthesia record keeping (ARK), CliniComp clinical information system (CIS), and VA s Veterans Health Information Systems and Technology Architecture (VistA). DataBridge provides for the collection, integration, access, and reporting of clinical data and supports inbound and outbound Health Level Seven (HL7) interfaces with VistA, inbound data from medical devices, record uploads to VistA Imaging, and data extracts. DataBridge provides a real-time interface between these clinical systems and VistA, allowing critical patient information, including physiological data, medications, laboratory results, patient assessments, orders, and clinical documentation, to be captured and made available within the Veteran s electronic health record. The system also supports the creation and storage of Portable Document Format records accessible through VistA Imaging and the Computerized Patient Record System. This integration enables clinicians within and outside the immediate patient care areas to access complete and timely patient information, supporting continuity of care, clinical efficiency, and patient safety. In addition to continued software licensing, maintenance, and support, this requirement includes DSS-performed installation, integration, and testing services necessary in connection with version upgrades to the existing Draeger ARK and CliniComp CIS environments. These services are required to ensure that the existing DSS DataBridge interfaces remain properly configured, integrated, and operational following the upgrades and continue to communicate successfully with VistA. Accordingly, the required software licenses, maintenance, support, and associated services must maintain compatibility with VISN 17 s existing DSS DataBridge infrastructure and functionality. No other source can provide the required DSS DataBridge annual software license subscriptions, maintenance, support, installation, integration and testing necessary to satisfy the Government s requirement. VISN 17 currently utilizes the DSS DataBridge solution to facilitate communication and interoperability between the VA clinical systems, including the Draeger ARK, CliniComp CIS, and VistA. The DataBridge solution provides the interface through which pertinent clinical data is communicated between these existing systems. The current requirement includes DSS DataBridge software licensing and maintenance/support, as well as 720 hours of technical installation services required in connection with the Draeger system upgrade. Although authorized resellers may provide the DSS software licenses, market research determined that the required installation, integration and testing cannot be performed by the resellers. DSS has confirmed that these services are performed by DSS technical personnel. Accordingly, the availability of authorized resellers for the software licenses does not provide an alternative source capable of performing the complete requirement. The technical services are necessary to support installation, configuration, integration, and testing associated with the Draeger upgrade and its continued interoperability with the existing DSS DataBridge environment. Because DSS possesses the proprietary technical knowledge and access necessary to perform these services within its DataBridge solution, another contractor could not independently perform the required work without DSS s involvement. title: DA10--DSS DataBridge Maintenance and Support (VA-27-00000586)
description: NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE The purpose of this synopsis is to announce the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Technology Acquisition Center s intent to award a firm-fixed-price sole source contract with Document Storage Systems Incorporated (DSS), located at 701 U.S.Highway One, Suite 101, North Palm Beach, Florida 33408. VA, Veterans health Administration (VHS), Veterans Integrated Service Network (VISN) 17 has a requirement for DSS DataBridge annual software license subscriptions, maintenance, support, and associated installation, integration and testing for its existing DataBridge environment. VISN 17 Health Care Systems currently utilize DSS DataBridge software licenses to facilitate communication and integration between the Draeger anesthesia record keeping (ARK), CliniComp clinical information system (CIS), and VA s Veterans Health Information Systems and Technology Architecture (VistA). DataBridge provides for the collection, integration, access, and reporting of clinical data and supports inbound and outbound Health Level Seven (HL7) interfaces with VistA, inbound data from medical devices, record uploads to VistA Imaging, and data extracts. DataBridge provides a real-time interface between these clinical systems and VistA, allowing critical patient information, including physiological data, medications, laboratory results, patient assessments, orders, and clinical documentation, to be captured and made available within the Veteran s electronic health record. The system also supports the creation and storage of Portable Document Format records accessible through VistA Imaging and the Computerized Patient Record System. This integration enables clinicians within and outside the immediate patient care areas to access complete and timely patient information, supporting continuity of care, clinical efficiency, and patient safety. In addition to continued software licensing, maintenance, and support, this requirement includes DSS-performed installation, integration, and testing services necessary in connection with version upgrades to the existing Draeger ARK and CliniComp CIS environments. These services are required to ensure that the existing DSS DataBridge interfaces remain properly configured, integrated, and operational following the upgrades and continue to communicate successfully with VistA. Accordingly, the required software licenses, maintenance, support, and associated services must maintain compatibility with VISN 17 s existing DSS DataBridge infrastructure and functionality. No other source can provide the required DSS DataBridge annual software license subscriptions, maintenance, support, installation, integration and testing necessary to satisfy the Government s requirement. VISN 17 currently utilizes the DSS DataBridge solution to facilitate communication and interoperability between the VA clinical systems, including the Draeger ARK, CliniComp CIS, and VistA. The DataBridge solution provides the interface through which pertinent clinical data is communicated between these existing systems. The current requirement includes DSS DataBridge software licensing and maintenance/support, as well as 720 hours of technical installation services required in connection with the Draeger system upgrade. Although authorized resellers may provide the DSS software licenses, market research determined that the required installation, integration and testing cannot be performed by the resellers. DSS has confirmed that these services are performed by DSS technical personnel. Accordingly, the availability of authorized resellers for the software licenses does not provide an alternative source capable of performing the complete requirement. The technical services are necessary to support installation, configuration, integration, and testing associated with the Draeger upgrade and its continued interoperability with the existing DSS DataBridge environment. Because DSS possesses the proprietary technical knowledge and access necessary to perform these services within its DataBridge solution, another contractor could not independently perform the required work without DSS s involvement. Separating the software from the associated technical services would not eliminate the Government s need for DSS to perform the required services. Regardless of the source through which the DSS licenses are acquired, DSS personnel would still be required to perform the 720 hours of technical installation services associated with the upgrade. Therefore, competition among resellers would not provide the Government with an alternative source capable of independently satisfying the entire requirement. No solicitation package will be issued. This notice of intent is NOT a request for competitive quotations. However, responses received by 09/28/2026 5:00 PM Eastern time will be considered.

Home Confinement services (for home confinement placements) are specifically defined in chapter 10, programs, of the aforementioned SOW. This will be a Firm-Fixed Price/IDIQ contract for services with a one-year base period, and four, one-year option period. The Home Confinement requirement will consist of a guaranteed minimum 10 placements (for the base year) and an estimated maximum 25 placements. description: Mit über 100 Jahren Erfahrung als eines der größten kommunalen Wohnungsunternehmen Berlins steht degewo für mehr als nur Wohnraum. Wir schaffen Lebensräume, die den Menschen ein Zuhausegefühl vermitteln – sicher, bezahlbar und zukunftsorientiert. Mit rund 83 000 verwalteten Wohnungen und rund 1.600 Mitarbeitern zählen wir zu den größten und leistungsfähigsten Wohnungsbauunternehmen in Deutschland. Unsere Bestände befinden sich in allen Stadtteilen Berlins, gegliedert in 55 Quartiere und verwaltet von 4 degewo-Kundencentern. Als kommunales Wohnungsunternehmen übernehmen wir Verantwortung für die Stadt Berlin und ihre Menschen. Damit einher geht unser Anspruch, den Service für unsere Kunden stetig zu verbessern, so dass wir den vielfältigen Bedürfnissen unserer Kunden entsprechen. Um den Service und die Leistungen für unsere Mieterinnen und Mieter kontinuierlich zu optimieren, fragen wir unsere Kunden regelmäßig nach Ihrer Meinung. Beschreibung der Leistungen: Befragungen und Erhebungen, wie z.B. Mieter- und Kundenzufriedenheitsbefragungen, Kundenfeedbackerhebungen, Mitarbeiterbefragungen, automatisierte Erhebungen zur Prozessoptimierung, Imagebefragungen, Quartiers- und Nachbarschaftsbefragungen, Mystery Shopping und vieles mehr. Der Rahmenvertrag Marktforschungsleistungen soll – auf deren gesondert zu äußernden Wunsch – auch für die städtischen Schwestergesellschaften von degewo (WBM, HOWOGE, Gesobau, STADT UND LAND, GEWOBAG) nutzbar sein.

buyer: Syndicat interdépartemental pour l'assainissement de l'agglomération parisienne (SIAAP)
title: France – Sewerage work – Sécurisation du fonctionnement hydraulique de la station de pompage VL2 à Villeneuve Saint Georges
description: La fiabilisation de la station de pompage interdépartementale VL2 située à Villeneuve Saint Georges appartenant au Syndicat Interdépartemental pour l'Assainissement de l'Agglomération Parisienne et exploitée par le conseil départemental du Val de Marne (Direction des Services de l'Environnement et de l'Assainissement). La station de relevage VL2 a été construite en 1991 afin d'alimenter la STEP de Valenton (Seine amont - SAM) avec les effluents collectés dans le Val de Marne et pour soulager ainsi Seine aval. Le présent projet consiste à mettre en application les résultats de l'étude de fiabilisation hydraulique et de l'AMDEC réalisées de 2016 à 2018 pour tout ce qui était noté en criticité inacceptable de degré 1, à savoir : - Modification du pompage permettant de garantir en continu les consignes de débits de la STEP quelques soient les occurrences de défaut des pompes, - Sécurisation de la bâche de refoulement, - Cloisonnement des TGBT et transformateurs, - Modification du système de dégrillage pour évacuer les broyats, - Changement des vannes d'entrées de poste. Les objectifs sont triples : - D'une part, garantir une disponibilité et le secours du pompage de VL2 en adéquation avec les objectifs épuratoires de SAM (débit de 6m3/s) et ainsi diminuer les routages vers SESAME et Charenton - D'autre part, fiabiliser les équipements de la station VL2 dont l'analyse des modes de défaillances (AMDEC) a mis en évidence une criticité inacceptable, - Enfin, améliorer la qualité de l'effluent relevé vers l'usine de Valenton en supprimant les refus de dégrillage à la source (volonté partagée sur la zone SIAAP pour diminuer l'ensablement du prétraitement et améliorer ainsi l'efficacité de la station d'épuration)

Przedmiot zamówienia musi być wolny od jakichkolwiek wad fizycznych i prawnych oraz roszczeń osób trzecich. 7. Dostarczony przedmiot zamówienia musi pochodzić z kanału dystrybucyjnego producenta niewyłączającego dystrybucji na rynek polski i zapewniającego realizację uprawnień gwarancyjnych. 8. Przedmiot zamówienia musi być dostarczony wraz z instrukcjami obsługi, sterownikami oraz ewentualnym oprogramowaniem towarzyszącym niezbędnym do prawidłowego korzystania z przedmiotu zamówienia (uzyskania pełnej funkcjonalności wskazanej w Części IV SWZ). Niespełnienie powyższych wymagań będzie skutkować odrzuceniem oferty odpowiednio na podstawie art. 226 ust. 1 pkt 17 albo pkt 19 ustawy Pzp. 10. title: Pre-Sol. Residential Reentry Services and Home Confinement Services located within the Hampton Roads, Virginia Metro Area to include the cities of Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Chesapeake, Newport News, Hampton, Portsmouth, Suffolk, Poquoson, and Williamsburg.
description: The Federal Bureau of Prisons is seeking concerns having the ability for providing Residential Reentry Center (RRC) services (in-house RRC beds) and Home Confinement services (home confinement placements) for male and female Federal offenders held under the authority of United States Statutes located within the Hampton Roads, Virginia Metro Area to include the cities of Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Chesapeake, Newport News, Hampton, Portsmouth, Suffolk, Poquoson, and Williamsburg. The geographical radius for Home Confinement is within 100 miles of facility. Both the RRC and the Home Confinement services shall be in accordance with the Federal Bureau of Prisons Statement of Work entitled, "Residential Reentry Center, March 2022 SOW�. Home Confinement services are specifically defined in chapter 10, Programs, of the aforementioned SOW. Additional requirements for these services are referenced throughout the SOW as well. This will be an indefinite delivery, indefinite quantity type contract with firm fixed unit prices for all line items. The RRC requirement will consist of an estimated maximum of 96 beds in which 86 beds will be designated for males and 10 beds designated for females for the One-year Base Period and each of the Four One-year Option Periods The Home Confinement requirement will consist of an estimated maximum of 75 placements to include both males and females for the One-year Base Period and each of the Four One-year Option Periods. It is the intent of the Government to award both line items (RRC and HC) to a single provider, as these services are interconnected and rely upon each other to ensure adequate programming and case management of offenders. The The Government reserves the right to potentially make an award which is deemed to be in the best interest of the Government. The Requst for Proposal (RFP) (solicitation) will be available after October 10, 2026, it will be distributed solely through the Government Point of Entry website, www.sam.gov. Hard copies of the solicitation will not be available. The site provides downloading instructions. Future information about this acquisition will also be distributed through this site. Interested parties are responsible for monitoring this site to ensure that they have the most up-to-date information about this acquisition. The estimated closing date of this solicitation (RFP) will be 60 days after the solicitation date. All responsible sources may submit a proposal which will be considered by this agency. No collect calls will be accepted. No telephone request or written requests for the solicitation will be accepted. Any questions regarding the pre-solicitation notice can be addressed to Rachel Brown at r16brown@bop.gov by 2:00PM MST on Friday, September 18, 2026.

description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. Quotes are being requested. The U.S. Forest Service, Region 6, has a requirement for the procurement and delivery of one (1) All-Terrain Vehicle (ATV) and four (4) snowmobiles. All vehicles must be delivered new, fully assembled, fluids serviced, and in a 100% turnkey state ready for immediate field deployment upon arrival to support field operations in the Pacific Northwest (PNW) National Forests. Schedule of Items & Delivery Locations All shipments shall be shipped FOB Destination and contract line item pricing must be fully inclusive of all freight, handling, and delivery charges. CLIN 0001: All-Terrain Vehicle (ATV) Quantity: 1 EA Delivery Location: Hood River Ranger Station, 6780 Hwy 35, Parkdale, OR 97041 CLIN 0002: Snowmobiles (#6120, #6121) Quantity: 2 EA Delivery Location: Deschutes National Forest, Scott Street Compound, 80 SE Miller Ave, Bend, OR 97702 CLIN 0003: Snowmobiles (#6678, #6680) Quantity: 2 EA Delivery Location: Siuslaw National Forest, 1850 NE Four Acre Place, Corvallis, OR 97330 Key Technical Salient Characteristics (see attached salient characteristics for additional specs) General (All CLINs): Brand new only; manufactured in the U.S.; minimum 1-year manufacturer warranty; one operators manual per vehicle. CLIN 0001 (ATV): 4-stroke liquid-cooled gasoline engine (600cc�800cc); automatic CVT transmission with H/L/N/R; selectable 2WD/AWD/4WD; single passenger; min 4.0-gallon fuel tank; weight under 800 lbs; wheelbase under 55 inches; integrated cargo racks; 1.25-inch rear receiver hitch. CLIN 0002 (Snowmobiles): 550cc�650cc liquid-cooled engine; Mandatory factory-installed spark arrestor; minimum 2-person seating; heavy-duty rear utility cargo rack kit compatible with 154-inch track footprint. Closing Date: Offers must be received no later than September 29, 2026, at 11:00 AM PDT. To be considered for award, the package must contain: SF-1449: Completed and signed (Blocks 17a, 30a, 30b, and 30c). Your Unique Entity ID (UEI) must be included in Block 17a. SF-30 Amendments: Acknowledged and signed copy of any posted amendments. Schedule of Items: Completed pricing using the provided Government form. title: GEC MD8060 Automated Scale Presses Industry Day
description: Special Notice Title of Event: GEC MD8060 Automated Scale Presses Industry Day Audience: Industry Representatives When: 7 April 2026, 0800-1600 Where: Air Force Metrology & Calibration (AFMETCAL) and the Air Force Primary Standards Laboratory (AFPSL), 813 Irving-Wick Dr. W., Heath, OH 43056 Abstract: The Air Force Metrology and Calibration Program (AFMETCAL) is hosting an Industry Day to provide information and gather feedback regarding the potential modification of the GEC MD8060 Automated Scale Presses. This event is critical for potential offerors to gain a comprehensive understanding of the current system and the specific requirements for its modification. The potential modification of the MD8060 would include removing the current hydraulic and electronic systems then installing a manually controlled hydraulic pump that maintains the MD8060�s accuracy of �0.025% rdg and range from 200 to 60,000 lbf. The primary objective of this Industry Day is to allow industry partners the opportunity to inspect the MD8060 firsthand at Air Force Primary Standards Lab (AFPSL). This on-site inspection is essential for understanding the requirement and developing an informed and effective solution. We encourage industry to identify potential risks and propose mitigation strategies related to the system modification. Potential offerors on any future solicitation are required to inspect the MD8060 on site, as they likely would not be able to submit a competitive proposal without a site visit. In no event shall failure to inspect the MD8060 on site constitute grounds for a claim after any resulting contract award. Objectives: Provide early engagement and communication to Industry Provide a forum to discuss modification strategies Improve the quality of any future solicitation Identify vendors interested and capable of executing modification of the MD8060 Who Should Attend? Both large and small businesses are encouraged to participate in this Industry Day event. For this Industry Day, the Government will permit a maximum of three (3) individuals per vendor to register and attend. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code to be used for this procurement is 334516 (Laboratory Analytical Instruments Manufacturing). Items for Discussion: To facilitate effective exchange, the Government requests questions in writing prior to the Industry Day. This will allow the Government to conduct research in advance of scheduled one-on-one sessions and come prepared to answer your questions. Please submit your specific questions to BOTH frank.capuano@us.af.mil and thomas.carson.2@us.af.mil. Answers may be limited as the Government is in the Market Research phase. The Government is not requesting capability statements or briefings at this time. Scheduled one-on-one sessions will allow interested vendors the opportunity to openly communicate with the Government by providing comments and inputs for consideration during the development of the solicitation. Times for the one-on-one sessions will be scheduled and communicated with registered attendees prior to the Industry Day. Sessions will be no more than 60 minutes and discussion will focus on the MD8060 requirements. In the event an interested party cannot attend on the scheduled date, an alternate date for a site visit will be accommodated as necessary to ensure maximum participation. To ensure transparency, non-proprietary questions and answers will be recorded, sanitized, and placed on SAM.gov. Please e-mail proposed topics and questions that you may have no later than 27 March 2026. Registration: Pre-registration is MANDATORY for attendance. Please submit the following information electronically to BOTH frank.capuano@us.af.mil and thomas.carson.2@us.af.mil no later than 2:00 PM EDT 27 March 2026 to pre-register. Information addressing security, directions, and individual session times will be provided to respondents. For this Industry Day, the Government will permit a maximum of three (3) individuals per vendor to register and attend. Only group registrations will be processed. The following information shall be provided for each attendee: 1. Individual attendees' full name and title 2. Individual attendees' e-mail address 3. Company name 4. Company Cage Code 5. Small Business Status 6. Telephone number 7. Visitor request form (To be provided upon notice of pre-registration) 7. Do you wish to have your company name included on a published list of attendees? Additional Information: Any submitted information may be used to structure future solicitations. Sensitive, proprietary, or otherwise confidential information must be marked appropriately in the response. Information received from respondents will not be shared with other vendors. Respondents will not be notified of the results of the market research. Additionally, information gathered through this meeting may influence RFQ development. This notification does not constitute an Invitation for Bids (IFB), a Request for Quote (RFQ), or a Request for Proposal (RFP) and it should not be construed as a commitment of any kind by the Government to issue a formal solicitation, award a contract, or conduct an acquisition in any particular way. The U.S. Government is in no way liable to pay for or reimburse any companies or entities that respond to this announcement. description: AMENDMENT 01 TO REMOVE YUKON FROM THE REQUIREMENT This published notice is not a solicitation. This document does not offer any commitments with respect to future purchases or contracts. The information in this notice is illustrative and may be revised as circumstances change. The purpose of this notice is to inform industry that Public Works and Government Services Canada (PWGSC) intends to establish new Departmental Individual Standing Offers (DISOs) to replace the expiring DISOs under EW699-220114 Multidisciplinary Environmental Services. The new DISOs will include the following consulting services for PWGSC’s Western Region: • Environmental impact assessments, permitting and studies o Environmental impact assessment o Permitting and regulatory support o Biological studies and investigations o Archaeological assessment • Environmental management of federal facilities o Environmental management and compliance o Hazardous building materials surveys o Air quality o Potable water sampling o Storage tank system audits • Contaminated sites consulting services o Phase I, II, III environmental site assessments (ESAs) o Geotechnical assessment o Human health and ecological risk assessment o Climate change risk assessment o Remedial options analyses /Evaluation and remedial action / Risk management action plans • Remediation planning, tender support, and supervision o Remediation planning o Site supervision and contract administration services o Cost estimating PWGSC plans to develop the upcoming multidisciplinary environmental services Request for Standing Offers (RFSOs) with the following structure: Publish four RFSOs on the CanadaBuys tender opportunities website, each aligned to a distinct geographic area and supplier eligibility requirements: 1. Prairies RFSO: Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba 2. Prairies PSIB RFSO: Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba, limited to Indigenous suppliers in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB) 3. Northwest RFSO: Northwest Territories 4. Nunavut RFSO: Nunavut Settlement Area, limited to Inuit firms registered on the Inuit Firm Registry Each RFSO will allow consultant firms to qualify for a DISO for the geographic area covered by that RFSO. ? Consultants may submit offers under more than one RFSO. ? Call-up distribution within each standing offer will be based on pre-determined percentages. ? Each standing offer will include two tiers, with separate call-up procedures as follows: 1. For requirements up to $100,000 (including applicable taxes), PWGSC may either: i. issue the call-up to the next firm on the rotation (rotational call-ups), ii. select the Offeror of their choice (selective call-ups) iii. compete the call-up on the basis of a work plan, level of effort, cost of disbursements and/or travel or Indigenous/Inuit commitments (competitive call-ups). 2. For requirements above $100,000 (including applicable taxes), PWGSC may either: i. issue the call-up to the next firm on the rotation (rotational call-ups), ii. direct a call-up to a firm with ‘best-fit’ justification (‘best fit’ call-ups), or iii. compete the call-up on the basis of a work plan, level of effort, cost of disbursements and/or travel or Indigenous/Inuit commitments (competitive call-ups /the pre-established unit rates of the standing offers will be respected). Each issued call-up will affect the order of priority of rotational call-ups to attain the ideal business volume distribution. Modern Treaties/Comprehensive Land Claims Agreements (CLCAs) Many of the multidisciplinary environmental services tool call-ups will be subject to modern treaties/CLCAs, which define the land and resource rights of Indigenous signatories and are intended to improve the social, cultural, political and economic well-being of the concerned Indigenous peoples. Accordingly, the RFSOs will include socio-economic benefits criteria designed to maximize opportunities for Indigenous businesses, labour, subcontracting and training. The Nunavut stream in particular will be exclusive to firms listed in the Inuit Firm Registry [https://inuitfirm.tunngavik.com]. Vendor Performance Management PWGSC will develop a vendor performance mechanism that is specific to the standing offers. The mechanism is designed to adjust the percentage distribution of call-ups according to the performance of each offeror. Buy Canadian Policy As part of the Government of Canada’s Buy Canadian Procurement Policy, the Policy on Prioritizing Canadian Suppliers and Canadian Content in Strategic Federal Procurements will apply to the RFSOs. Where applicable, each RFSO will include the required clauses and certifications. The session will begin at 10:00 AM Mountain Daylight Time. If you wish to participate in the information session, please provide in writing to ( Nafissa.diop@pwgsc-tpsgc.gc.ca ) the Standing Offer Authority, the name(s) of the person(s) who will be attending and a list of questions they wish to table, no later than September 16, 2026. title: Coburn Gore LPOE Art in Architecture Project
description: Document Added & Updated: 0332CG-AIA- Coburn Gore AIA Questions & Answers V2 Dated 09 September 2026 The U.S. General Services Administration (GSA) Art in Architecture Program commissions American artists (citizens and Lawful Permanent Residents or Permanent Workers of the United States) to create publicly scaled and permanently installed artworks for Federal buildings nationwide. GSA announces an opportunity for a Federal art commission in conjunction with the new construction of the Coburn Gore Land Port of Entry (LPOE) in Coburn, Maine. The new facility will strengthen supply chains, improve operational capabilities and facility infrastructure, spur economic growth, and bolster the country�s security. The project will provide a fully operational LPOE that coordinates with the tra?c ?ow and operations of the Canadian port of entry at Saint-Augustin-de-Woburn Quebec, Port of Entry. The project will provide a new port that allows Customs and Border Protection to more efficiently carry out its agency mission, their operations and interactions with the public. GSA allocates one-half of one percent (0.5%) of the estimated construction costs of new or modernized Federal facilities for art commissions. The art budget for this project is estimated to be between $275,000 to $400,000. One or more artists will be awarded a fixed-price contract for a commission. Artists who wish to be considered for this GSA art commission must submit application materials to GSA by the SAM Contract Opportunity�s Response Date. Artists may also elect to be considered for all future GSA art commissions by submitting application materials to GSA�s National Artist Registry (Registry). Instructions on how to submit application materials and join the Registry are available on the following Web site: https://www.gsa.gov/real-estate/design-and-construction/art-in-architecturefine-arts/art-in-architecture-program/art-in-architecture-national-artist-registry All artists who wish to be considered as candidates for a commission at the LPOE in Coburn Gore, ME must have their application materials submitted and received by GSA by 12:00 PM Eastern Time on 30 September 2026. Artists� submissions received after the deadline will not be considered for this project but will be eligible for consideration on future GSA commissions alongside the other artists on the Registry. Artists already on the Registry need not resubmit but may elect to update their information prior to the deadline. GSA evaluates artists based on the following criteria: the media, materials, content and style of the artist�s past work, along with the artist�s past performance and experience with commissions or projects similar to the one described in this synopsis. Shortlisted artists will be contacted and asked to submit additional information, including a statement that the artist can perform the work associated with the GSA commission within the identified budget. GSA will count the combined weight of all the selection criteria as significantly more important than price. At minimum, the scope of services for this commission will require collaboration with the lead designer selected for the land port of entry project; travel to the project site; development and presentation of preliminary and final concepts; fabrication of the artwork; participation in meetings and conservation reviews as necessary; delivery and installation of the artwork; professional documentation of, and detailed maintenance planning for the artwork at the project site. For informational purposes: Artists selected for the contract award must be Permanent Residents or Citizens of the United States of America. Artists selected for the contract award will be required to have an active registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) at the time of award. Instructions for creating an account and activating registration in SAM may be found at www.sam.gov. Artists selected for the contract award will be required to renew the registration in SAM on an annual basis for the duration of the project. In accordance with Executive Order (EO) 13934, agencies should prioritize the commission of works of art that portray historically significant Americans or events of American historical significance or illustrate the ideals upon which our Nation was founded. Inquiries concerning the project should be directed to the following email address: Molly.Lewis@gsa.gov and reference the synopsis number in the subject line.
